sourceStatus: No new player data; synthetic example only; original 2024 Reddit report lacks actual completed-cast denominator
collectionInstructions: Capture the actual Retail build/patch, observation UTC time, input rank, exact spell, profession skill, specialization/unlocks, profession tool/gear, and relevant stats with units. Keep unknown as null, not zero.
Start a new snapshot whenever skill, gear, spec, unlocks, patch or input rank changes; never pool different snapshots.
Use Mycobloom rank 1 (210796) and rank 2 (210797) in separate cohorts, each with ten nominal herbs per Khaz Algar Milling operation (spell 444181 if confirmed).

Record one unique event for every attempted operation. Count COMPLETED only after actual successful completion. Aborted/failed Create All operations and requestedBulkCasts never count as zero-result casts.
For every completed cast, record full output item-ID quantities, including explicit target 222619 count zero when no Nacreous Pigment R2 appears. Preserve co-outputs and item ranks.
If any completed cast has incomplete output capture, set countsByItemID=null, complete=false and block the snapshot's P and E; never silently omit it.
Record gross required ten input herbs separately from actual Resourcefulness refunds and net spent. Refunds are input cost, not produced output; do not adjust per-cast E by net-input denominators.
Preserve player/study-family/session ancestry. Derivative exports are not independent samples. Independent validator must hold out an unrelated whole author/study family.
Begin with a pilot sample and expand for rare outcomes; do not assert fixed sample sufficiency or hypothetical maximum yields.
Do not promote raw descriptive P/E or observed positive support to current-Retail economic or tooltip fields without independent QA and applicable context validation.

statusSemantics.COMPLETED: Confirmed completed cast; eligible denominator only if complete output capture

formulas.P: positive completed casts / all completed casts, if every completed cast has complete output
formulas.E: sum output units including zero casts / all completed casts, same completeness gate
formulas.yieldMin: minimum observed positive yield, null if no positive results
formulas.yieldMax: maximum observed positive yield, null if no positive results

denominatorPolicy: requestedBulkCasts is metadata, never the denominator. Missing output from even one confirmed completed cast blocks P/E for the cohort.
uncertainty: No current Retail sample or independent holdout; descriptive sample bounds are not guaranteed game bounds. No generic stat coefficient.
blockers: Historical bulk aborts cannot supply zero-output denominators
